title: Disclose it right
subtitle: FTC rules for videos and live streams, as a checklist
sections: In the post or video itself, hard to miss.
Video: say it AND show it on screen.
Live: repeat it during the stream.
Avoid: sp, spon, collab, a lone 'thanks' or 'ambassador'.
A platform label may not be enough alone.
steps: Add a spoken + on-screen line to your next paid video.
Put 'Ad' in the first line of the caption.
sources: FTC: Disclosures 101 for social media influencers
video: Disclose in the video, not just the caption
